home.eyebrow: Old Nicosia · Est. for good times
home.title: Come hungry. Stay a little longer.
home.body: Brunch that rolls into cocktails, plates made for sharing, and a room that always feels like the right place to be.

home.title: Brunch, unhurried
home.body: Late mornings, excellent coffee and generous plates — served from 10:30.

home.title: Drinks with intent
home.body: Seasonal cocktails, local beer and a wine list made for lingering.

home.title: Dinner, shared
home.body: Mediterranean produce, open-flame cooking and plates for the whole table.

menu.title: Food worth gathering around
menu.body: Our menu follows the day: bright brunch plates, generous sharing food and thoughtful drinks. Ask the team about today’s specials.

about.eyebrow: Our corner of the old town
about.title: A neighbourhood place with a restless spirit
about.body: The Gym is where Nicosia meets from late morning until late at night — a bar, a kitchen and a familiar table, all under one roof.

about.title: Produce first
about.body: We start with the season and source with care, letting Cyprus lead every plate.

about.title: Open to everyone
about.body: Coffee at the bar, a long brunch, one last drink — arrive exactly as you are.

about.title: Made for Nicosia
about.body: Local flavours, international curiosity and the energy of the old city around us.

reservations.title: Make a reservation
reservations.body: Join us for brunch, dinner or drinks in the heart of old Nicosia. For groups of eight or more, please call us directly.

reservations.title: Good to know
reservations.body: We hold tables for 15 minutes. Outdoor seating is available on request and subject to weather. The entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible.
